title: Final locked R2 hydrology interface export through 2024
purpose: Provide state-consistent total, fast-origin, slow-origin and direct-origin Reach flow plus explicit reservoir storage, release and water-age diagnostics for subsequent TN transport modelling.
observation_use: None. This stage is deterministic export from the locked hydrologic structure and frozen forcing.
forbidden: redefinition of fast and slow origin after routing
claim_boundary: Fast/slow labels identify parent DYN2P source origin after conservative reservoir mixing. They are not independently observed reservoir release components. Individual reservoir operations remain prior-constrained rather than release-observation-identified.
